nodes.label: Teardown-always guarantee with cooperative cancellation
nodes.author: Perfscale Team
nodes.rationale: Teardown must run on normal completion, load-phase error, and SIGINT/SIGTERM — chosen over teardown-on-success-only because cleanup after a failed run is exactly when it is needed. This drags in a signal handler, cooperative VU cancellation, a run-once latch (end-of-duration and Ctrl-C can race), and a bounded teardown timeout; SIGKILL/OOM honestly break the promise and must be documented bluntly.

nodes.label: Setup/teardown metrics isolation
nodes.author: Perfscale Team
nodes.rationale: Setup/teardown http steps must not record into the run histogram: load metrics describe the load phase only, and a 2s fixture-creation POST would wreck p99 — this is the concrete reason 'just prepend setup to steps:' is wrong. v1 disables recording entirely; a separately-reported setup-duration metric is a documented future.
